articles.title: Strategy to repurchase $1.5 billion of 2029 convertible bonds using cash or bitcoin sales
articles.snippet: Led by Michael Saylor, the company aims to retire half of its outstanding 0% 2029 converts as it restructures liabilities tied to its bitcoin treasury strategy.

articles.title: OKX, Korea Investment and Securities said to be in talks for 40% of Coinone
articles.snippet: OKX's planned move into the South Korean market would echo that of Binance, which completed its acquisition of Seoul-based Gopax last year.

articles.title: BloFin War of Whales 2026 Grand Prix opens registration for $5M trading championship
articles.snippet: BloFin, a prominent global cryptocurrency exchange, has officially opened registration for its highly anticipated trading competition, the WOW (War of Whales) 2026 Grand Prix.

articles.title: OKX reportedly eyes Coinone stake in South Korea push
articles.snippet: OKX is reportedly seeking a 20% stake in South Korean crypto exchange Coinone as foreign and domestic firms compete for market access.

articles.title: Signal hints it could leave Canada over lawful access bill
articles.snippet: Signal's vice president of strategy said the firm “would rather pull out of the country” than comply with Bill C-22, which could threaten end-to-end encryption.
